mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM u_user_coin_record WHERE direction = 1 AND biz_type != 'withdraw_refund' AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_id AS userId, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM u_user_coin_record WHERE direction = 1 AND biz_type != 'withdraw_refund' AND is_deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id

SELECT user_id AS userId, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM u_leaderboard_income_submission WHERE period_month = #{periodMonth} AND audit_status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user_id AS userId, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM u_leaderboard_income_submission WHERE period_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '-%') AND audit_status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user_id AS userId, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM u_leaderboard_income_submission WHERE period_month = #{periodMonth} AND audit_status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id

SELECT user_id AS userId, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM u_leaderboard_income_submission WHERE period_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '-%') AND audit_status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id

SELECT e.user_id AS userId, SUM(e.amount) AS amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.invitee_id) FROM u_user_invite_relation r WHERE r.inviter_id = e.user_id AND r.effective_status = 1) AS inviteCount FROM u_earnings_record e WHERE e.type = 'INVITE_REWARD' AND e.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.user_id HAVING inviteCount > 0 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.user_id AS userId, SUM(e.amount) AS amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.invitee_id) FROM u_user_invite_relation r WHERE r.inviter_id = e.user_id AND r.effective_status = 1) AS inviteCount FROM u_earnings_record e WHERE e.type = 'INVITE_REWARD' AND e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY e.user_id
